A Travel Data Pass provides a fixed amount of data for use on your mobile phone or device while traveling outside Canada, helping to manage data roaming costs. Without a data pass, data can be used at the pay-per-use rate for the country you are traveling to, up to a maximum of $100 per billing period, after which a data pass must be purchased to continue using data while roaming. If you subscribe to Roam Better, a Travel Data Pass is needed for destinations not covered by Roam Better.

You can purchase a data pass up to 30 days before your trip or at any time while traveling. The pass activates once you start using data while roaming and is valid for 30 days before it expires. If more data is needed, multiple passes can be purchased, and a second pass will automatically activate once the data in the first pass is used.

To purchase a data pass on your mobile device:
1. Launch the MyBell app.
2. Select your device.
3. Select Travel & roaming.
4. Enter a destination in the search bar.
5. Select the country from the drop-down list.
6. Select View travel features.
7. Choose a data pass and select Continue.
8. Follow the prompts to complete your purchase.

To purchase a data pass on bell.ca:
1. Log in to MyBell and select your Mobility service.
2. From the My services page, click Add or remove features.
3. Under Available features, click Travel.
4. Select the destination(s).

There are various Travel Passes available:
*   **International 30-day Travel Pass**: Offers unlimited talk & text within your destination and back to Canada, plus use of data from your rate plan while traveling. It costs $110 for 30 days. To add, text INTL30 to 4400. This pass activates immediately upon addition to your account and expires 30 days later at 11:59 p.m. (ET). It is recommended to add the pass the day your trip starts, before you arrive.
*   **International 14-day Travel Pass**: Includes unlimited talk & text within your destination and back to Canada, plus use of data from your rate plan while traveling. It is available with most monthly plans and Small Business plans. To add, text INTL14 to 4400. This pass activates immediately and expires 14 days later at 11:59 p.m. (ET). It is recommended to add the pass the day your trip starts, before you arrive.
*   **U.S. 30-day Travel Pass**: Offers unlimited talk & text within your destination and back to Canada, plus use of data from your rate plan while traveling. It costs $70 for 30 days. To add, text US30 to 4400. This pass activates immediately and expires 30 days later at 11:59 p.m. (ET). It is recommended to add the pass the day your trip starts, before you arrive.
